message.content:
Sure! Here’s a sample 7‑day itinerary for a memorable trip to Paris (adjust dates and preferences as needed):

| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|-----|---------|-----------|---------|
| **1** | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle or Orly – transfer to your hotel (e.g., Le Marais, Latin Quarter, or near the Louvre). | Check‑in & settle. Light stroll along the Seine, visit Notre‑Cathédrale (outside) and Île Saint-Louis. | Dinner at a classic bistro (Le Coupe Chou or Chez L'Ami Jean). |
| **2** | Breakfast at Café de Flore or Les Deux Magots. Visit Louvre Museum (arrange skip‑the‑line tickets). | Lunch in the Palais Royal gardens. Walk to Sainte‑Chapelle & Conciergerie. | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches). |
| **3** | Early morning visit to Eiffel Tower (book tickets online). | Picnic at Champ‑de‑Mars. Explore Trocadéro Gardens. | Dinner in Montmartre – try Le Consulat or La Maison Rose. |
| **4** | Day trip to Versailles (train RER C). Tour Palace & Gardens. | Return to Paris, relax at Jardin des Tuileries. | Optional cabaret show at Moulin Rouge or Lido. |
| **5** | Explore Musée d’Orsay (Impressionist masterpieces). | Lunch at Musée de l’Orangerie café. Walk through the Champs‑Élysées to Arc de Triomphe. | Dinner in the 8th arrondissement – perhaps Le Cinq or Frenchie. |
| **6** | Visit Sacré‑Coeur & explore Montmartre streets. | Lunch at a local crêperie. Free time shopping in Le Marais or Galeries Lafayette. | Nighttime Seine walk or dinner cruise. |
| **7** | Last‑minute souvenir shopping. Visit Luxembourg Gardens. | Pack & check‑out. Transfer to airport. | Depart. |

### Practical Tips

| Topic | Recommendation |
|-------|----------------|
| **Flights** | Book round‑trip economy or business class from major hubs. Use airlines like Air France, Delta, or Lufthansa. |
| **Accommodation** | Mid‑range: Hotel Henriette (Marais), Hotel Ekta (Champs‑Élysées). Luxury: Four Seasons George V, Ritz Paris. |
| **Transport** | Purchase a Navigo Week Pass (€22.80) for unlimited metro/bus rides. Consider a bike rental (Velib’) for short trips. |
| **Dining** | Reserve restaurants ahead (especially for Michelin‑starred places). Try local specialties: escargot, coq au vin, macarons. |
| **Tickets** | Pre‑buy Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Musée d’Orsay, and Versailles tickets online to avoid queues. |
| **Language** | Learn basic French phrases; most Parisians speak English in tourist areas. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables secure; watch out for pickpockets near major attractions. |
| **Weather** | Pack layers; Paris weather can be unpredictable. Bring comfortable walking shoes. |

Feel free to tweak the schedule based on your interests—whether you’re into art, history, food, or simply strolling through charming neighborhoods. Enjoy your trip!
